seo.title: About KLUB | Pilates Reformer Studio Limassol
seo.description: KLUB — Keep Living Under Balance — is a premium reformer Pilates studio opening in Limassol city center in September 2026. Small groups, private sessions, warm space.

hero.heading: Keep Living Under Balance
hero.intro: That's what KLUB stands for — and what the studio is built around.

space.heading: The Space
paragraphs: Warm plaster walls, arched doorways, dried botanicals and soft, indirect light. The studio was designed to feel less like a gym and more like an exhale — a place where the pace of the city stops at the door.
On the floor: professional reformer machines, capped at six per class, arranged so every person has space to move and be seen by their instructor.
space.afterQuote: It's painted on our wall, and it is a promise. No intimidation, no competition — just intentional movement, mindful strength and real connection.

images.alt: Cozy white sofa lounge corner with warm lamp light at KLUB Pilates studio Limassol
Black Pilates springs, balls and equipment displayed in arched cream niches at KLUB Limassol

cards.title: Intentional Movement
cards.text: Every exercise has a purpose. We teach you what you're doing and why, so strength comes with understanding.

cards.title: Mindful Strength
cards.text: Progress that lasts is built with control, not chaos. Six people per class means your form always comes first.

cards.title: Real Connection
cards.text: A studio should know your name. Ours will — and the community forming around it is the part we're most excited about.
